correctness.rationale: Every generic section vertex corresponds to a crossed rook-graph edge; all additive-threshold sign patterns are Ferrers diagrams, and every such diagram is realizable. The exact cell-weight identity reduces the extremum to inclusion of all strictly positive cells, exclusion of negative cells and free diagonal zero cells. Direct summation gives the stated all-dimensional closed form and equality patterns; a small generic perturbation bounds nongeneric sections. The extracted standard-library checker reproduces 76,792 diagram enumerations, 823 exact-rational intersection checks and 9 unrestricted-cut comparisons. Finite cases are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The result answers a natural all-dimensional extremal face-complexity question for a fundamental polytope family with a sharp closed formula, exactly characterizes all generic extremizing sign patterns, and quantifies the nontrivial asymptotic 2/3 gap relative to unrestricted skeleton cuts. This cannot be obtained merely by evaluating the universal section bound on a product.
